globalNews.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
globalNews.summary: In an exclusive interview with the BBC’s Steve Rosenberg, Dmitry Muratov says the Kremlin leader can only "destroy Ukraine, not conquer it", with the war now in its fifth year.

globalNews.title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
globalNews.summary: The UK government says it is "disrupting and deterring shadow fleet vessels" in accordance with the law.

globalNews.title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
globalNews.summary: Two Palestinian families in the village of Qusra say they have been trapped in their homes, with water and power cut off, since Sunday.

globalNews.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
globalNews.summary: The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

globalNews.title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
globalNews.summary: In the comments, Kelce called Swift his "wife" for first time and said it was a "childhood dream" to wed at Madison Square Garden.

cryptoNews.title: Bitmine’s $257M annualized staking income ‘fills’ operational gaps, share buybacks: analysts
cryptoNews.summary: Bitmine’s Ether staking revenue is an important financial buffer that fills financial gaps and provides recurring revenue streams beyond Ether’s price appreciation, analysts told Cointelegraph.

cryptoNews.title: MUFG PoC to bring Japanese government bond repo transactions onchain
cryptoNews.summary: MUFG’s experiment plans to bring Japanese government bond repo transactions onchain to achieve 24/7 settlement, as well as improved capital and operational efficiency.

cryptoNews.title: SEC allows Franklin Templeton funds to invest in onchain money fund
cryptoNews.summary: The SEC said it will not pursue enforcement action if Franklin Templeton’s funds start investing cash in the asset manager’s own tokenized money market fund.

cryptoNews.title: ‘DeFi doesn’t exist anymore,’ just onchain finance: Andre Cronje
cryptoNews.summary: Flying Tulip founder Andre Cronje contends that DeFi protocols have evolved into a new financial paradigm of “onchain finance,” but have sacrificed some of their inherent immutability and decentraliza

cryptoNews.title: Binance bStocks pass xStocks as second-largest tokenized stock issuer
cryptoNews.summary: Binance bStocks became the second-largest tokenized stock issuer less than two months after launch, narrowly ahead of Kraken’s xStocks.

aiNews.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
aiNews.summary: Is Anthropic's new watermarking system a travesty? Some have taken to social media to complain that it is.

aiNews.title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers’ content by default, unless they opt out
aiNews.summary: "If this was opt-in, nobody would opt in," Twitch CPO Mike Minton said on a livestream responding to user feedback. "That's honestly the answer."

aiNews.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
aiNews.summary: Cognition may be looking to raise another mega round just a few months after raising $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.

aiNews.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
aiNews.summary: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

aiNews.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
aiNews.summary: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.
